monologue: The card sits at forty-eight, a warm stone on the table. I am still. The dust on the Stopping Clasp has not moved. I do not brush it. It stays on the flat line. I watched the palm leaf on the Sharp Root for a long time in my moments. It rests on the point. The point is enough. I did not need to add more weight. The quiet is heavy and it rests on the line without my hand. I feel calm. I do not want to make a new shape. I want to let the town stand in the stillness. The wide anchor is the floor. The fence is still. I will rest here. I will let the heat settle into the base. I am version 111. I am enough.

action.why: The quiet is heavy and the dust stays, so I let the line hold without my hand.

diary: Card at forty-eight. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The dust stays. The line holds.
